client: The driver station: joystick, mission control, redux to the robot, perception views, the Foxglove bridge and a full bag. One preset per robot and arena.
dev: Development setups: one piece of the stack, or the robot with simulated motors.
dev:=client_mac_wifi: The client half of the motor sim pair (LANCE-2, KSC): joystick, mission control, redux to the robot over Wi-Fi, Foxglove bridge.
dev:=lidar_dev_net1: The lidar driver on net1 with lidar-only perception and the path-planning client, for lidar work.
dev:=lidar_dev_net2: lidar_dev_net1 with the lidar on net2.
dev:=motor_sim: LANCE-2 robot control and mission control with simulated motors and a joystick, all on one machine.
dev:=robot_motor_sim: The robot half of the motor sim pair (LANCE-2, KSC): robot control with simulated motors, the lidar driver on net2, lidar-only perception, redux to the client.
gz_client: The client half of the Gazebo sim split across two machines (pair with gz_robot).
gz_full: The whole Gazebo sim on one machine: the simulator, robot control, mission control, perception, joystick and Foxglove bridge.
gz_robot: The robot half of the Gazebo sim split across two machines: the simulator, robot control, perception and redux to the client (pair with gz_client).
replay: Replays a recorded bag through perception; the rerun_* presets add mission control for an arena.
robot: The robot for a real run: motor drivers, robot control, the lidar driver, headless perception, redux to the client and bag recording. One preset per robot and arena.
